short_description.id: White Tiger adalah Harimau Putih dalam Empat Lambang rasi Tiongkok.
short_description.en: White Tiger belongs to the Four Symbols of Chinese constellations.

long_description.id: White Tiger adalah Harimau Putih dalam Empat Lambang rasi Tiongkok. Harimau Putih berhubungan dengan arah barat dan musim gugur.
long_description.en: White Tiger belongs to the Four Symbols of Chinese constellations. The White Tiger corresponds to west and autumn.

long_description.id: Nama lintas bahasanya meliputi Byakko di Jepang dan Baekho di Korea. Wilayah rasi Harimau Putih mencakup tujuh kedudukan bulan.
long_description.en: Its names in neighboring traditions include Japanese Byakko and Korean Baekho. The White Tiger's constellation region contains seven lunar mansions.

long_description.id: Huainanzi bab Tianwen xun mengaitkan barat dengan logam dan menyebut Harimau Putih sebagai binatang arah itu, sedangkan Liji bab Quli shang menempatkannya di sisi kanan dengan Naga Biru di sisi kiri. Dalam bacaan Werner, Naga Biru dan Harimau Putih menjalankan di kuil Tao tugas yang di kuil Buddha dijalankan Heng dan Ha di gerbang. Werner juga menceritakan Yin Ch'eng-hsiu, yang gugur ketika berusaha membalas ayahnya dan kemudian diangkat sebagai Roh Bintang Harimau Putih.
long_description.en: The Huainanzi chapter Tianwen xun associates the west with metal and names the White Tiger as the beast of that direction, while the Liji chapter Quli shang places it on the right with the Azure Dragon on the left. In Werner's account, the Blue Dragon and White Tiger discharge in Taoist temples the functions that Heng and Ha discharge at Buddhist temple gates. Werner also tells of Yin Ch'eng-hsiu, who died trying to avenge his father and was later canonized as the Spirit of the White Tiger Star.

title.id: Yin Ch'eng-hsiu menjadi Roh Bintang Harimau Putih
title.en: Yin Ch'eng-hsiu becomes the Spirit of the White Tiger Star

role.id: Tokoh yang diangkat sebagai Roh Bintang Harimau Putih
role.en: The figure canonized as the Spirit of the White Tiger Star

summary.id: Menurut Werner, Yin Ch'eng-hsiu berusaha membalas kematian ayahnya, gugur oleh tombak, lalu diangkat sebagai Roh Bintang Harimau Putih.
summary.en: According to Werner, Yin Ch'eng-hsiu tried to avenge his father's death, fell to a spear, and was canonized as the Spirit of the White Tiger Star.

note.id: Liji menempatkan Naga Biru di kiri dan Harimau Putih di kanan; di kuil Tao keduanya menjalankan tugas penjaga yang sama.
note.en: The Liji puts the Azure Dragon on the left and the White Tiger on the right; in Taoist temples the two discharge the same gate functions.

sources.title: Myths and Legends of China (bab "Blue Dragon and White Tiger")
sources.author: E. T. C. Werner

claims.quote: is one of the Four Symbols of the Chinese constellations. It is sometimes called the White Tiger of the West

statement.id: White Tiger adalah Harimau Putih dalam Empat Lambang rasi Tiongkok.
statement.en: White Tiger belongs to the Four Symbols of Chinese constellations.

claims.quote: It represents the west in terms of direction and the autumn season.

statement.id: Harimau Putih berhubungan dengan arah barat dan musim gugur.
statement.en: The White Tiger corresponds to west and autumn.

claims.quote: It is known as Byakko in Japanese, Baekho in Korean, and Bạch Hổ in Vietnamese.

statement.id: Nama lintas bahasanya meliputi Byakko di Jepang dan Baekho di Korea.
statement.en: Its names in neighboring traditions include Japanese Byakko and Korean Baekho.

claims.quote: As with the other three Symbols, there are seven astrological "Mansions" (positions of the Moon) within the White Tiger. The names and determinative stars are:

statement.id: Wilayah rasi Harimau Putih mencakup tujuh kedudukan bulan.
statement.en: The White Tiger's constellation region contains seven lunar mansions.

claims.quote: 西方，金也，其帝少昊，其佐蓐收，執矩而治秋。其神為太白，其獸白虎，其音商，其日庚辛。

statement.id: Huainanzi bab Tianwen xun (天文訓) menyebut bahwa arah barat adalah logam (金), kaisarnya Shaohao (少昊), pembantunya Rushou (蓐收) yang memegang penyiku dan mengatur musim gugur (治秋); rohnya adalah Taibai (太白) dan binatangnya (獸) adalah Harimau Putih (白虎).
statement.en: The Huainanzi chapter Tianwen xun (天文訓) says the west is metal (金), its emperor is Shaohao (少昊) and its assistant Rushou (蓐收), who holds the square and governs autumn (治秋); its spirit is Taibai (太白) and its beast (獸) is the White Tiger (白虎).

claims.quote: 左青龍而右白虎，招摇在上，急繕其怒。進退有度，左右有局，各司其局。

statement.id: Liji bab Quli shang (曲禮上) menempatkan Naga Biru (青龍) di sisi kiri dan Harimau Putih (白虎) di sisi kanan, dengan 招摇 (Zhaoyao) di atas; gerak maju-mundur berpedoman pada aturan dan tiap bagian memegang tugas masing-masing.
statement.en: The Liji chapter Quli shang (曲禮上) puts the Azure Dragon (青龍) on the left and the White Tiger (白虎) on the right, with 招摇 (Zhaoyao) above; advance and retreat follow rules and each part keeps its own post.

claims.quote: The functions discharged by Heng and Ha at the gates of Buddhist temples are in Taoist temples discharged by Blue Dragon and White Tiger.

statement.id: Werner menulis bahwa tugas yang dijalankan Heng dan Ha di gerbang kuil Buddha dijalankan di kuil Tao oleh Blue Dragon (Naga Biru) dan White Tiger (Harimau Putih).
statement.en: Werner writes that the functions discharged by Heng and Ha at the gates of Buddhist temples are discharged in Taoist temples by Blue Dragon and White Tiger.

claims.quote: The Spirit of the White Tiger Star is Yin Ch'eng-hsiu. His father, Yin P'o-pai, a high courtier of the tyrant Chou Wang, was sent to negotiate peace with Chiang Tzu-ya, but was seized and put to death by Marquis Chiang Wen-huan.

statement.id: Werner menyebut bahwa Roh Bintang Harimau Putih adalah Yin Ch'eng-hsiu, putra Yin P'o-pai, pejabat tinggi istana tiran Chou Wang yang dikirim berunding damai dengan Chiang Tzu-ya tetapi ditangkap dan dihukum mati oleh Marquis Chiang Wen-huan.
statement.en: Werner states that the Spirit of the White Tiger Star is Yin Ch'eng-hsiu, whose father Yin P'o-pai, a high courtier of the tyrant Chou Wang, was sent to negotiate peace with Chiang Tzu-ya but was seized and put to death by Marquis Chiang Wen-huan.

claims.quote: His son, attempting to avenge his father's murder, was pierced by a spear, and his head was cut off and carried in triumph to Chiang Tzu-ya. As compensation he was, though somewhat tardily, canonized as the Spirit of the White Tiger Star.

statement.id: Menurut Werner, putra itu berusaha membalas kematian ayahnya tetapi ditombak dan kepalanya dipenggal serta dibawa dengan kemenangan kepada Chiang Tzu-ya; sebagai ganti rugi ia, meski agak terlambat, diangkat sebagai Roh Bintang Harimau Putih.
statement.en: According to Werner, the son, trying to avenge his father's murder, was pierced by a spear and his head was cut off and carried in triumph to Chiang Tzu-ya; as compensation he was, though somewhat tardily, canonized as the Spirit of the White Tiger Star.

gaps.searched: Ilustrasi dalam artikel tidak dipakai tanpa pemeriksaan berkas Commons, kecocokan subjek, dan lisensinya; belum ada gambar yang terverifikasi untuk entri ini.

Sumber tambahan: Huainanzi (Tianwen xun) dan Liji (Quli shang) di Wikisource Mandarin, serta Werner, Myths and Legends of China (Project Gutenberg). Shiji juan 27 dibuka (menyebut rasi Shen sebagai harimau putih) tetapi kutipannya tertanam dalam catatan tafsir sehingga tidak dipakai.
Bagian lain (kemampuan, kelemahan, penggambaran modern) tidak diisi karena belum ada kutipan yang mendukungnya.
